notes.text:
Spent the afternoon repairing the school observatory's paper star chart.

From the single damaged polyester transparency labelled Zenith-7:
I cut three narrow strips for reinforcing the chart's fold and two wide tabs for attaching it to its display frame. All five cut pieces were already translucent when I cut them.

Separately, I reserved four balcony seats and two aisle seats for the choir's Tuesday concert. The six ticket confirmations are saved in my inbox.

I'm trying the newly borrowed voice recorder #StoneHarbor for the first time. It recorded this rehearsal more clearly than the old EchoLeaf recorder.

The concert organiser's note says to bring a printed confirmation if phone screens are prohibited. I have not printed my confirmation yet.
